name: Melissa Michelson
office: City of Alhambra, Member of the City Council, Fifth District

items.text: Melissa Michelson is a professor and the former vice chair of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission. Her campaign says she helped organize the Measure V campaign, which brought campaign finance reform and district elections to Alhambra.

sentences.text: Melissa Michelson is a professor and the former vice chair of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission.
Her campaign says she helped organize the Measure V campaign, which brought campaign finance reform and district elections to Alhambra.

items.text: She proposes a Legacy Business Program to support longtime small businesses. At a 2026 City Council meeting, she spoke against federal ICE enforcement and requested the council discuss policies. She also called for a moratorium on data center construction in Alhambra. Her campaign says she wants to invest in environmental stewardship and improve the city's 2026 sustainability plan.
